comparison.objective: Post a packet completely through a spring-flap drop-box slot.
comparison.physical_skill: Grasp selection, flap actuation by the object, constrained insertion, release, and follow-up pushing.
comparison.success_condition: Packet fully inside and stationary with the flap shut; a packet stuck in the slot fails.
comparison.reason: This is one-way packet insertion through a flap. It does not require mating two support rails or preserving freely circulating elements across their junction.
